sentences.en: If your windows are not airtight, moisture will seep in.
sentences.zh: 如果你的窗户不够密闭，湿气会渗进来。

sentences.en: This food will keep for a week in an airtight container.
sentences.zh: 这种食物放在密封容器里可以保存一周。

sentences.en: Preserves must be stored in a jar with an airtight seal.
sentences.zh: 果酱必须储存在有密封盖的罐子里。

senses.zh: 无瑕疵的：no, flaw; 密封的，不透气的：impermeable to air
